preconditions.name: oracle_clears_competence_floor
preconditions.description: The greedy nearest-resource ORACLE (ceiling anchor, no agent) must clear COMPETENCE_RESOURCE_FLOOR resources/episode, proving the floor is ACHIEVABLE in this exact env so the yardstick's scale is calibratable. Below-floor => the floor is not achievable here (env too sparse/lethal) => substrate_not_ready_requeue, NEVER a capability verdict.
preconditions.control: greedy nearest-resource oracle forager, same ENV_KWARGS/seed, no agent

preconditions.name: zworld_world_encoder_trained
preconditions.description: P0 warmup moved at least one split_encoder.world_encoder tensor, i.e. z_world is a prediction-trained encoder rather than a frozen random projection
preconditions.control: the P0 warmup itself, on the arm's own training env at the arm's own p0 episode count -- the phase whose stated job is to train the world model

This arm's z_world is a FROZEN RANDOM PROJECTION at initialisation, NOT a prediction-trained encoder, so any result it produces is uninterpretable as evidence about z_world. Known cause: no optimizer in _train_all_on_agent covers a latent_stack parameter (P0 trains e2; P1 trains the lPFC bias + OFC devaluation heads), and the P0 loop buffers latent.z_world.detach(), so no gradient reaches the world encoder. See REE_assembly/evidence/planning/zworld_bc_install_failure_V3-EXQ-780_2026-07-19.md. If a frozen random projection is the DELIBERATE condition under test, pass require_trained_encoder=False so the choice is explicit and auditable in the manifest.

evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-728 TRAINED ALL-ON CAPABILITY POINT (experiment_purpose=baseline, claim_ids=[], non_contributory -- EXCLUDED from governance scoring; PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING). WS-3 of ree_ai_design_critique_plan.md: lands the TRAINED all-ON stack on ALL FOUR claim-agnostic capability metrics (foraging_competence, survival_horizon, goal_reach_rate, planning_depth) against the V3-EXQ-727 random-floor / greedy-oracle scale, closing WS-3's 'reported alongside every all-ON run' clause. The all-ON stack (714 ARM_ON) is trained with the V3-EXQ-724 A0 recipe: P0=200 world-model warmup THEN P1=90 two-head REINFORCE (lateral-PFC bias + OFC devaluation), SD-056 e2 encoder FROZEN through P1 (e2_train_in_p1=False), then evaluated via the yardstick's REEForwardPolicy. Readiness: oracle clears the 1.0 floor (oracle_forage/ep=6.333333, clears_floor=True); yardstick_discriminates=True. Self-route (HYPOTHESIS, not a verdict): readiness_met=True -> label=substrate_not_ready_requeue. REPORTED CONTEXT (not a governance verdict): trained-all-ON majority_supra_floor=False, normalized_position={'foraging_competence': -0.024725, 'survival_horizon': 5.631218, 'goal_reach_rate': -0.08, 'planning_depth': -0.221428}. Eval uses the reusable yardstick's mechanism-agnostic REEForwardPolicy (no P2 OFC-viability injection), so the number is comparable to 727's p0warmup point and is NOT required to reproduce 724's A0 P2 competence DV byte-for-byte. Z_WORLD UNTRAINED-ENCODER GUARD (STRICT, arm-scoped to ree_trained_allon; DETECTION ONLY): arm_green=False, seeds_checked=3, seeds_failed=3; per_arm_gate green=['random_walk', 'greedy_oracle'] red=['ree_trained_allon']; non_degenerate=True (ANY arm green -- a refused ree_trained_allon arm does NOT vacate the random_walk / greedy_oracle anchors, which run no P0 warmup and whose premise does not involve z_world). trained_allon_capability_valid=False.
